name: 1942 Tetrimino Edition
description: Classic 1942-style vertical scrolling shooter with Tetrimino-shaped enemies. Features animated title screen, endless waves with smooth progressive difficulty scaling, huge scaling bosses, power-up system with auto-fire, and detailed end-game statistics.
features: Animated title screen with shooting plane and flying formations
Endless wave-based gameplay with smooth difficulty progression
6 Tetrimino enemy types + TETRIS letters + 8 strange symbols (20 total)
Auto-fire toggle (Button A) - no more carpal tunnel!
Power-up system with stackable wing guns (max 3 levels)
Power-ups act as shields before losing lives
Boss battles every 60 seconds with scaling size (2x to 8x HUGE!)
Boss health scales infinitely (+5 HP per wave)
Detailed end-game statistics (Score, Wave, Shots, Kills, Accuracy%)

waves.wave_1_to_5: Regular Tetriminos with progressive difficulty scaling
waves.wave_7_plus: Mix of everything - Tetriminos, letters, and symbols with endless scaling

max_difficulty_reached.description: All difficulty metrics maxed except boss health which scales infinitely

statistics_tracking.displayed_on: Game Over screen with Score and Wave

memory_usage.optimization: Plenty of headroom for future features

flashing.note: Merged binary includes bootloader, partitions, and firmware - ready to flash to blank ESP32

Tetris (1984) - Block-based visual style and shapes

gameplay_tips: Use Auto-Fire (Button A) to save your thumb!
Collect power-ups early - they're shields AND firepower
Focus on dodging over shooting - bullets are infinite
Boss patterns: Learn the side-to-side movement timing
Later waves: Stay mobile, don't camp in corners
Accuracy matters for high scores - make shots count
God Mode (Button B) is great for practicing patterns
